observation: The first Read clipboard action after production Copy Link blocked the app event loop. The copied-link equality expectation failed at 87.51 seconds. Failure hierarchy collection also stopped responding; the unchanged 300-second gate deadline ended xcodebuild. The incomplete xcresult contained no exportable screenshot.
cause_scope: A synchronous UIPasteboard.general.url read in the owned simulator fixture is the observed stall boundary. No process stack proves a pasteboard daemon, host synchronization or permission cause. PasteboardAutomaticSync was already disabled and verified; that mitigation alone did not prevent recurrence.
passed_before_failure: production SwiftUI and C/Objective-C interoperability compilation, linking and signature verification
native profile normalization/account lifetime and Swift profile model tests, including the relocation/callback diagnostics correction
owned window, clock/title/haptics, preview lifecycle, playback/audio and one-shot launch fixtures
testGlassControls (185.812 seconds), including clipboard, resolution, rendered motion and pixel opacity checks
not_reached: preview-panel, thumbnail and channel-profile coordinate gates
physical-device validation of corrected profile access
correction: Use the genuine SwiftUI PasteButton accepting URL in the test fixture instead of a synchronous main-thread general-pasteboard read. Keep real production Copy Link and UIKit Share Copy writes and exact pasted-URL equality checks. Clear the pasteboard and displayed result before each round trip so an old success cannot satisfy a later check. Require both glass/plain clipboard pass markers.
preserved: three fresh direct-copy and one system-share round trip per controls style
existing production controls, playback, account and native profile adapters
scoped host pasteboard synchronization preference restoration
limits: This correction changes only the owned test fixture and its admission checks; authenticated profile access still needs device validation.
